description:
A record of the hottest newcomers born from the fingertips of two legendary masters. The 'Hell Camp' short story collection, produced by Lee Hyeon-Se and Lee Du-Ho, is finally unveiled. Witness the overwhelming first steps of 23 rookies who will change the landscape of the webtoon world in 2026!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories included:
1. **Miso Upgrade**(미소 업스레이드) \[Kkaesuil\]
2. **Sohwakaeng!** (소확행!) \[Olhae\]
3. **Dongsaeng** (동생) \[Cha-Ho\]
4. **100-wonui Yonggi** (100원의 용기) \[Yasaengma\]
5. **Jeollyeogui Jeollyeogeul Dahae!** (전력의 전력을 다해!) \[Gyoun\]
6. **Egensilgyeok** (에겐실격) \[Angmi\]
7. **Soboksobok** (소복소복) \[Manbul\]
8. **Yugiui Ire** (유기의 이레) \[Gamcheu\]
9. **Seonmul** (선물) \[KYUNG\]
10. **Naui Jageun Neungsohwa** (나의 작은 능소화) \[Jjigae\]
11. **Han Ipman!** (한 입만!) \[Eunggun\]
12. **Urideurui Chinjeolhan Iut** (우리들의 친절한 이웃) \[Do-Ryeong\]
13. **Bin Bang Ihuui Uri** (빈 방 이후의 우리) \[Gam-Ja Wang\]
14. **Kkeopdegi** (껍데기) \[Song\]
15. **Neorang Danduri** 너랑 단둘이) \[Bamlim\]
16. **Siyagak** (시야각) \[Nenem\]
17. **What's Your Name** (왓 유얼 네임) \[Eun-Ji\]
18. **Johwa** (조화) \[Injung e\]
19. **Sintokkijeon!** (신토끼전!) \[Sae-Ha Min\]
20. **Maeumedo Yutonggihani Innayo?!** (마음에도 유통기한이 있나요?!) \[Neungso\]
21. **Jumuneul Dowajuseyo!** (주문을 도와주세요!) \[Nyagamjeon\]
22. **Annyeong Naui Manyeonim** (안녕 나의 마녀님) \[Beomji\]
23. **Dangyeonhi Jul Su Isseo!** (당연히 줄 수 있어!) \[Gaga\]
